basic_info.description: Welcome to 785 39th Avenue, a masterfully reimagined home where timeless elegance meets modern luxury. This 4-bedroom, 3-bath residence has been meticulously renovated with impeccable attention to detail, offering a rare blend of sophistication, comfort, and functionality. Step inside to discover sun-drenched interiors framed by Marvin windows and adorned with wide-plank white oak floors. The heart of the home is a chefs kitchen designed for both beauty and performance, featuring Thermador appliances, a wine refrigerator, and a striking waterfall island perfect for gatherings. Retreat to the spa-inspired bathrooms showcasing sleek finishes and contemporary design, or entertain outdoors in the expansive, fully landscaped backyard, complete with EV charging for modern convenience. Perfectly situated in SF's coveted Outer Richmond, this home offers the best of city living with a neighborhood feel. Enjoy morning coffee and dining nearby, strolls through Balboa Park, and the endless trails, gardens, & cultural destinations of Golden Gate Park. Grocery stores nearby, and public transit provides easy access to downtown and beyond. Its more than a home-- its a lifestyle. Dont miss this rare opportunity to experience elevated living in one of the city's most sought-after enclaves.
